title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - EatingActivitySensor
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/EatingActivitySensor. Eating activity sensor. Subclass of saref:Sensor (SAREF core class, not modeled here); inherited saref:Sensor vocabulary is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent. See the ex:Cow_Eating_Activity_Sensor_33 example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1, Figure 8: two eating-activity measurements of the ex:Cow3 are reported, each measured in time:minute. The example's 'observes'/isValueOfProperty' target in the published figure is annotated ex:MilkYield, which appears to be a documentation artifact (MilkYield fits a MilkingSensor, not an eating-activity measurement); this model instead maps EatingActivitySensor to the s4agri:Intake named individual ('the amount of food or other substance taken into the body of an animal'), the semantically fitting property for this sensor -- an explicit modeling assumption, called out here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'EatingActivitySensor'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

observes.description: Property/Relationship. saref:observes. The s4agri:Property named individual this sensor measures: 'the amount of food or other substance taken into the body of an animal'. IRI: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Intake.

hasFeatureOfInterest.description: Relationship. saref:hasFeatureOfInterest. The Animal (or AnimalGroup) this measurement is about, e.g. ex:Cow3 in the ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1 example.

value.description: Property. saref:hasValue. The last eating-activity duration measured by the sensor, per the ex:Cow_Activity_2019_03_01_15_00 example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1, Figure 8 (measured in time:minute).

unitCode.description: Property. saref:isMeasuredIn. The unit of measure for 'value', e.g. 'minute' (time:minute), per the ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1 example.

dateObserved.description: Property. The date and time this measurement was made.
